hypothesis: One causal same-asset same-direction nearest-neighbor filter may improve the unfiltered20x policy and10x control without increasing planned account risk.

learning.prices: H1 closes ending exactly at S, never the delay or fill candle; ATR is existing closed daily signal ATR.
learning.distance: Unweighted squared Euclidean on the two dimensionless features. Same symbol and same sign only. Expanding historical training from earliest available valid daily signal. Equal distance: earlier signal first.
learning.label: Independent US$100 reference paper trade,20x,1% risk, base costs, original BTC gate, liquidity, stops, lots, liquidation buffer, funding and24h deadline. Net PNL/planned risk. No labels for ineligible entries. Verified M5 only where previously frozen; otherwise conservative H1.
learning.release: Label becomes usable only at hypothetical entry+24h+1h embargo, even if stopped earlier. release_at<=current signal_at. All label exit observations must end<=entry+24h+1h. Future prices/rates never used to build an available label.
learning.signal_rule: Require at least20 matured same-symbol/same-side labels; average R of nearest20 strictly>0. Otherwise reject signal. Base-cost training used unchanged for base and stress evaluation. Preserve relative-BTC rank among approved eligible entries.
learning.warmup: No synthetic prehistory and no reset at evaluation block boundary. Earlier genuine historical labels may train later blocks. No symbol pooling or fitted global scaler.

evaluation.control: Reproduce all8 full existing10x relative wallets exactly. Check eligible independent labels against one-entry full replay. Check filter predictions from prefix-only observations.
evaluation.acceptance: Exploratory only: filtered20x continuous ROI strictly exceeds both unfiltered20x and10x in base and stress; maximum continuous base H1 DD<=10%; at least20 continuous closed trades per cost; all3 separate periods positive both costs; no modeled liquidation or unresolved new ambiguity.
evaluation.search: Exactly one frozen k=20 model, two features, positive mean-R threshold and1h embargo. No tuning or replacement after outcomes. No after-outcome stop tightening or relaxation of liquidation buffer.

unchanged: planned1% loss budget inclusive modeled costs/funding reserve
limitations: Previously explored historical data; sequential causal learning is not independent validation.
Nearest neighbors are a fixed exploratory hypothesis, not proof that recurring patterns predict the future.
Current catalog/universe survivor bias; simulated fills and approximate isolated liquidation; H1 marked drawdown.
Insufficient training or20x-compatible stops can cause no trades. Retain that outcome.
